name: caveat_brush
description: Caveat is a handwriting type family designed by Pablo Impallari. It is designed for short annotations. For a different style, there is also a sister family, Caveat The fonts have OpenType features that enable the letters to have slight variations according to their occurrence within a word, for a natural handwritten feel.
